query:
UPDATE hebergement.formule
        SET prix_mineur = $2,
            duree_min_minutes = $3,
            duree_max_minutes = $4,
            heure_arrivee_standard = $5,
            heure_depart_standard = $6,
            jours_autorises = $7,
            assujettie_taxe_nuitee = $8,
            regle_conversion_taxe = $9,
            prix_heure_supplementaire_mineur = $10,
            modifie_le = now()
        WHERE id = $1
        RETURNING id
